english.note: Use this when something is funny or ridiculous, especially when the humour is unintended.

exampleSentences.english: They look so serious that it actually seems comic.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢個樣咁認真，反而好笑。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 go3 joeng6 gam3 jing6 zan1 faan2 ji4 hou2 siu3

english.note: Use this when the ridiculous thing is funny or invites mockery, rather than merely being extreme.

exampleSentences.english: The way you are putting on that act is ridiculous.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng2 baan6 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 siu3
